releases.name: 0.10.0 — Plan-guard and title fixes, cost cap, literal flags, agent authority, pinned installs
releases.body:
# v0.10.0 — Plan-guard and title fixes, cost cap, literal flags, agent authority, pinned installs

Two defects reproduced against **live OpenCode 1.18.25 and 1.18.29** are fixed, two contributions from forks are ported with credit, agent tools gain an authority setting, and the install docs now explain why an unpinned plugin never updates.

## Fixes

### Plan-mode guard fails open on a session's first command
OpenCode runs `command.execute.before` before any chat hook for the turn, and its `Session` record carries no `agent` field, so the 0.9.0 "session record fallback" could never learn the agent for a `/goal <objective>` sent as a fresh session's first turn. The goal started live and the routed text told the model to start working. Reproduced over the HTTP `command` API with `agent: "plan"` (the path `opencode run --agent plan` uses too).

The routed turn *does* carry the agent. `chat.message` now re-evaluates the planning-only restriction for the goal that command created and, when the agent is restricted, holds the goal (`plan agent active`, budget preserved), rewrites the turn as a read-only control turn, and blocks tools for it. A completion marker on that turn does not complete the held goal. Pinned by a new mutation-contract entry.

### Stale `▶` in the session title after completion
With `sessionTitleStatus`, completion archived the goal and the title sync returned early, leaving the last running line on the session until `/goal clear`. A completed goal now renders as `✅ ship the release · 3 turns · 2m · 45k`; `/goal clear` still restores your original title.

## Ported from forks

- **Cost cap** — `maxCostUsd` plugin option and `--max-cost` per-goal flag. The goal pauses with the usual wrap-up prompt once the cumulative API cost OpenCode reports reaches the cap (`max cost reached ($5.00)`). `/goal status` shows `Cost budget: $spent/$cap`, the continuation budget carries `cost_remaining_usd`, the near-limit warning fires within 10% of the cap, and `goal_set`/`set_goal` accept `maxCostUsd`. An unknown provider cost never trips the cap; one response may overshoot. Idea and first implementation by [@NiklasTR](https://github.com/NiklasTR).
- **Fenced literal flags** — a ```` ```fence``` ```` in `/goal` arguments is objective text verbatim: `/goal run ```pytest --maxfail=1``` and fix failures` no longer rejects with `Unsupported flag: --maxfail`. Ported from [@NiklasTR](https://github.com/NiklasTR).

## New option

- **`agentGoalAuthority`** — `"full"` (default, unchanged) or `"status"`. In `"status"` mode the agent tools may complete, block, pause, resume, and create a goal when none is live, but `goal_set`/`set_goal` refuse to replace an active goal (an `agent_authority` failure envelope on the canonical tool), `update_goal` refuses objective changes, and `clear_goal` refuses to clear — a model can no longer rewrite the objective you gave it. Prompted by [@felores](https://github.com/felores)'s fork.

## Install docs: pin your version

OpenCode resolves an unpinned `"opencode-goal-plugin"` entry to `@latest` **once**, installs it under `~/.cache/opencode/packages/opencode-goal-plugin@latest/`, and never re-resolves while that directory exists. Anyone who followed the old README is still on whichever version they first installed. The README now pins the version (`"opencode-goal-plugin@0.10.0"`), documents the upgrade path (bump the pin, or delete the cached directory), mentions `opencode plugin <name>@<version>`, and `npx opencode-goal-plugin` warns when the unpinned cache lags the package. `npm install` was never required and is gone from the instructions.

## Also

- `zod` 4.4.3 → 4.5.4; CodeQL action v4.37.9.
- OpenCode 1.18.29 added to the compatibility table from a deterministic-provider canary against a real `opencode serve` process.
- `ledgerFilePath` documented; `file://` checkouts noted to need `node_modules`.

## Upgrading

releases.name: 0.9.0 — Plan-mode safety and a live status indicator
releases.body:
# v0.9.0 — Plan-mode safety and a live status indicator

Both features in this release were verified against a **live OpenCode 1.18.25 TUI**, not unit tests alone.

## Plan-mode safety

A goal set while a planning-only agent is active is now **recorded but held** instead of starting.

Auto-continue already paused when a session switched to Plan mid-goal. This closes the creation path: previously `/goal <objective>` typed in Plan mode created a *live* goal and ran the loop before any idle occurred, and the routed command text told the model to start working.

A held goal:

- records `stopReason: plan agent active` and keeps its full budget
- sends **zero auto-continues**
- is announced through a read-only control turn that tells the model not to begin work

Run `/goal resume` after switching to an executing agent to start it.

The active agent is read from the host's execution context, falling back to the session record. That fallback is what makes the restriction work in practice: OpenCode runs `command.execute.before` before `chat.message`/`chat.params`, so the context is empty for the first command in a session — exactly the case a freshly opened Plan-mode session hits.

### New options

| Option | Default | Controls |
|---|---|---|
| `restrictedAgents` | `["plan"]` | Agent names treated as planning-only (case-insensitive). `[]` releases the restriction. |
| `allowGoalExecutionFromPlan` | `false` | Allow creation and auto-continue while a restricted agent is active. |

The default-on behavior is pinned by the mutation contract.

### Scope

The restriction stops the **goal loop**. It cannot stop a model acting on the **single routed command turn**, because OpenCode's `command.execute.before` does not fully intercept command text. A held goal's routed text explicitly instructs the model not to begin work, but a non-compliant model may still act once. Build-mode behavior is unchanged.

## Session-title status indicator (opt-in)

Set `sessionTitleStatus: true` to mirror live goal status into the OpenCode session title, which the TUI renders persistently:

```
▶ ship the release · 3/10 · 2m · 45k/200k
```

Status icon, objective, auto-continues used / limit, elapsed, and context tokens / budget. `▶` running, `⏸` paused, `⛔` blocked — blocked outranks paused because it needs you, not just a resume.

- Off by default; it overwrites a user-visible field.
- The original title is captured before the first overwrite and restored by `/goal clear`.
- An unchanged render skips the API call, so read-only commands cost nothing.
- Refreshes on commands and on idle/compaction/interruption — never on the `message.updated` events that stream during a turn, keeping API round-trips out of the response path.
- Status lines written by a previous process are recognized as the plugin's own, so a restart followed by `/goal clear` cannot promote stale goal status to the session's permanent title.
- Failures log at debug level and never interrupt the goal loop.

No TUI plugin entrypoint, no `@opentui` dependencies, no build step.

## Compatibility

**OpenCode 1.18.25** added to the tested matrix, backed by a real run: the goal command and native `goal` agent register, session-sharded persistence works, a Plan-mode goal is held with zero auto-continues, and evidence-gated completion closes cleanly with `[goal:evidence]` + `[goal:complete]`.

The `>=1.17.15 <2` engine range already covered it, so no pin change.

**OpenCode 2** is documented as unsupported *and untested* — not known-broken — with a concrete checklist of what a supported claim would require. This plugin is server-only, so its configuration lives entirely in `opencode.json` on any OpenCode line.

- 414 tests
- mutation contract 68/68 critical mutants killed
- behavior benchmark score 100

# opencode-goal-plugin v0.7.0

This release makes goal lifecycle state visible at the moments users need it,
while keeping notification delivery outside the correctness path.

## Highlights

- `/goal status` now explicitly reports `active`, `paused`, or `blocked` and
  identifies the configured completion-audit mechanism.
- `/goal list` preserves stopped state and reason for the focused goal.
- Meaningful transitions produce bounded structured-log and TUI-toast notices
  without extra model turns or disclosure of full objectives, evidence, or
  filesystem paths.
- New `lifecycleMessages` and `lifecycleMessenger` options independently control
  lifecycle visibility without changing audit messages.
- Terminal persistence and rollback are hardened against overlapping session
  changes, and blocked-ledger recovery preserves the concrete blocker.
- The README now labels the v0.6.6 command-presentation results as historical
  and separately records the OpenCode 1.18.11 host-integration canary.

## Compatibility

- Node.js: `>=18`
- OpenCode: `>=1.17.15 <2`
- Existing `Active goal:` output remains intact for compatibility.

The candidate passed 350 tests, the complete release gate, 67/67 mutation
checks, the 100/100 behavior benchmark, clean exact-tarball consumer checks, and
a real OpenCode 1.18.11 localhost-provider canary.

# opencode-goal-plugin v0.6.8

Version 0.6.8 keeps OpenCode usable when two processes open the same session,
without weakening the plugin's single-writer safety guarantees.

## Fixed

- Serialize fresh-namespace migration-marker publication so concurrent first
  starts cannot race a shared marker rename on Windows.
- Keep a same-session contender in passive goal mode instead of failing the
  whole plugin initialization. Ordinary chat and unrelated tools remain
  available.
- Prevent a passive process from reading, changing, persisting, prompting, or
  auto-continuing the leased session's goal state.
- Return the stable `session_owned_elsewhere` code from canonical goal tools
  and an actionable ownership explanation from `/goal` commands.
- Retry ownership only at a fresh explicit goal-command or goal-tool boundary.
  After the owner exits, recovered active work is loaded paused rather than
  restarting unattended.
- Preserve the session's Plan/model/variant execution context across takeover,
  while preventing delayed controls, disposal, or logging from mutating a
  newer goal run.

## Lease safety and compatibility

- Use immutable per-owner claims so delayed publication, simultaneous stale
  reclaim, and concurrent release cannot remove a replacement owner's lease.
- Publish a complete compatibility guard atomically, preventing older and
  current plugin versions from both winning startup.
- Bound owner-record reads, avoid symlink traversal, sanitize diagnostics, and
  fail closed on legacy, incomplete, tampered, future, or unsupported layouts.
- Automatic same-session handoff requires all participating processes to run
  0.6.8. If every possible owner is closed and an invalid lease layout remains,
  follow the recovery steps in the README and compatibility guide; preserve
  the goal state and lifecycle ledger.

## Verification

- 330/330 tests passed.
- 66/66 critical mutation tests were killed.
- Behavior benchmark: 100/100.
- Type, source smoke, packed-host, packed-tool, verifier, production audit,
  clean-install, and package-content gates passed.
- Corrective exact-main CI and CodeQL passed, including Linux, macOS, Windows,
  Node 18/20/22/24, and the complete quality/package gate.
- Real-host acceptance passed on OpenCode 1.17.15 and 1.18.11.

Full details: https://github.com/willytop8/OpenCode-goal-plugin/pull/46 and
https://github.com/willytop8/OpenCode-goal-plugin/pull/48

# opencode-goal-plugin v0.6.7

Version 0.6.7 makes `/goal` controls deterministic on the affected OpenCode
hosts and restores the complete goal-tool surface for standard clean installs.

## Fixed

- Route `/goal status`, `/goal list`, `/goal history`, and other handled
  commands by mutating OpenCode's retained prompt parts in place, so ambiguous
  raw arguments no longer reach the selected model.
- Authenticate resolved command turns and frame control results with escaped,
  direct reporting instructions.
- Preserve verified file attachments while failing closed on missing,
  malformed, forged, replayed, cross-session, or unsupported attachment
  expansion.
- Prevent control replies—including overlapping and multi-step replies—from
  completing, blocking, checkpointing, or falsely advancing an autonomous
  goal.
- Block all tool calls while a control or attachment-error result is being
  reported.
- Register all 11 goal tools in a normal clean install using the package's
  exact runtime Zod dependency; `@opencode-ai/plugin` is no longer required.

## Verification

- 287/287 test assertions passed.
- 23/23 critical mutation tests were killed.
- Behavior benchmark: 100/100.
- NodeNext and Bundler type contracts passed.
- Packed-host, packed-tool, verifier, audit, and package-content gates passed.
- Production dependency audit found zero vulnerabilities.
- Real-host acceptance passed on OpenCode 1.17.15 and 1.18.10 on macOS.
- Fresh Debian 13.6, Node 22.23.2, and OpenCode 1.18.10 acceptance passed.
- Post-merge CI and CodeQL passed on the exact issue-fix merge commit.

Full details: https://github.com/willytop8/OpenCode-goal-plugin/pull/43
